name: EINSTEIN Matchmaker synthetic dataset
note: Synthetic. Every person, company, publication, project and patent is invented; any resemblance to real ones is a coincidence. Institutions are real faculties of the University of Novi Sad, used as a setting only.

companies.name: AgroLens d.o.o.
companies.about: Farm management software for mid-size grain farms in Vojvodina and Hungary: field records, spraying plans, satellite crop maps.

challenges.text: Farmers want a yield estimate per parcel by mid-June, but our maps only show crop vigour.
Ground truth for soil moisture costs too much: probes are expensive and we can't place them on every parcel.

companies.plans: Launch a yield-forecast product for 2027 and expand to Romania.

companies.name: Polje Senzor d.o.o.
companies.about: Pravimo bežične senzorske stanice za voćnjake: temperatura, vlažnost lista, padavine. Stanice rade na bateriju i šalju podatke preko LoRaWAN mreže.

challenges.text: Baterije u stanicama zimi traju upola kraće nego leti, pa voćari moraju da ih menjaju usred sezone.
Voćari ručno broje leptire na feromonskim klopkama; hteli bismo da kamera na klopci to radi sama.

companies.name: FreshPak Solutions
companies.about: Packaging for fresh fruit and vegetables, mostly for exporters of berries to the EU.

challenges.text: Raspberries for Germany arrive with mould on day 9; buyers want 14 days.
Big retailers will stop taking conventional plastic lidding film by 2028; we need a compostable one that still seals.

companies.past_collaborations: Tested packaging with a faculty lab in 2020.

companies.name: Zlatni Klas Mlin a.d.
companies.about: Flour mill near Novi Sad producing wheat flour and semolina.

challenges.text: We sell 18,000 tonnes of bran a year as cheap animal feed; we'd like a higher-value use.
Electricity is our second-largest cost and peaks at bad times.

companies.name: GridSense Analytics
companies.about: Analytics for electricity distribution operators in the Western Balkans: asset registers, outage analysis, network planning.

challenges.text: Operators want to know which distribution transformers will fail next year; they have dissolved gas analysis results and load data, but no model.
Rooftop PV is changing feeder loads; operators need a day-ahead forecast per feeder.

companies.rd_capacity: Five engineers, one with a PhD.

companies.name: VoltCell Storage
companies.about: Builds stationary battery storage from second-life electric vehicle batteries for farms and small factories.

challenges.text: We can't tell how healthy a used battery module is without a full test cycle that takes 20 hours.

companies.name: LinguaBot d.o.o.
companies.about: Customer-support chatbots for banks and telecoms in Serbia.

challenges.text: Our search misses answers because Serbian words change form (e.g. 'kartica', 'karticu', 'karticom') and users mix Latin and Cyrillic.
Clients want the bot on the phone too; speech recognition for Serbian is poor on call audio.

companies.name: CardioTrack d.o.o.
companies.about: A 7-day ECG patch with an app for cardiologists.

challenges.text: Too many false atrial fibrillation alarms when patients move.
We need a clinical validation study in Serbia before CE marking.

companies.name: InspektAI
companies.about: Visual quality control for factories: cameras on the line, software that flags defects.

challenges.text: Scratches on polished metal parts: reflections fool our model, and clients only have a few dozen defect photos.
Clients want inference on cheaper edge devices than Jetson.

companies.name: HidroLogik d.o.o.
companies.about: Software for municipal water utilities: network maps, meter data, billing integration.

challenges.text: Utilities lose 30–40% of water; they have pressure sensors in a few zones but can't say where the leak is.
Forecasting daily water demand for pumping plans.

companies.name: ReVita Water
companies.about: Designs and builds wastewater treatment units for food and pharmaceutical plants.

challenges.text: A pharmaceutical client must remove drug residues (diclofenac, carbamazepine) that our biological step doesn't catch.
Membranes in dairy plants foul quickly and need cleaning every week.

companies.rd_capacity: Process engineer and a lab technician.
companies.past_collaborations: Sampling campaign with a faculty in 2019.

companies.name: BuildTwin d.o.o.
companies.about: BIM modelling and consulting for public building projects.

challenges.text: Cities want to retrofit 40 schools but don't know which to do first for the biggest energy savings per dinar.

companies.name: RouteWise
companies.about: Route planning and delivery tracking for couriers and retail chains.

challenges.text: Same-day deliveries with narrow time windows: our planner takes too long when orders change during the day.
Retail clients ask us to forecast store demand so deliveries match it.

companies.name: SecureEdge Labs
companies.about: Security monitoring for factories and building management systems.

challenges.text: We need to detect unusual behaviour on Modbus and BACnet networks without labelled attack data.
Clients ask whether our firmware signing will survive quantum computers.

companies.plans: Certify under the EU Cyber Resilience Act.

companies.name: Kredo Fintech
companies.about: Online loans for micro and small businesses.

challenges.text: Micro firms often have under a year of history; our scoring rejects good borrowers.
The central bank wants every automated decision explained.

companies.name: DriveCore Software
companies.about: Embedded software services for automotive tier-1 suppliers.

challenges.text: Writing ISO 26262 test cases by hand takes most of our verification budget.
We need a cheaper hardware-in-the-loop bench for smaller projects.

companies.name: PrintMetal 3D
companies.about: Metal 3D printing service for tooling and spare parts.

challenges.text: Porosity in 316L parts fails customer pressure tests in about 1 of 12 builds.
Four printers, many small orders: we schedule builds by hand.

companies.name: MlekoSmart d.o.o.
companies.about: Ogrlice za krave koje mere aktivnost i preživanje i aplikacija za farmere.

challenges.text: Farmeri žele upozorenje na mastitis pre nego što se vide simptomi.

companies.name: NebulaQ
companies.about: Quantum algorithms for drug discovery clients abroad.

challenges.text: Error mitigation on today's noisy quantum hardware for molecular simulation.

companies.plans: Partner with a quantum hardware vendor.

companies.name: HempTex Vojvodina
companies.about: Grows and processes industrial hemp into fibre for textiles.

challenges.text: Our decortication line damages long fibres, which lowers the price we get.
